newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Aegon still looking out for acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Aegon still looking out for acquisitions.

text.p: Dutch insurer Aegon NV said on Monday its agreement to buy the insurance arm of Providian Corp of the United States may not be the end of its expansion plans.
Aegon chairman Kees Storm told a press conference the company was still on the look out for acquisitions and had over one billion guilders left in resources.

"We're able to do this because we have the money available and if there are nice opportunities, we'll look at them," he said. He did not specify any particular target companies but highlighted the Spanish market as one area of interest.
Storm added that the Providian deal would generate benefits of synergy and he expected Aegon's U.S. units to perform well next year, growing slightly above the sector average.

"This record-setting acquisition is fully in line with Aegon's stated strategy. It is earnings enhancing, highly compatible and will provide a healthy boost to our growth into the next century. It is consistent with our patient, disciplined approach to acquisitions," he said in a statement.
